dis.text: Momir Vig, guildmaster of the Simic, proposes pitting Razia and the Azorius sky marshals in a bidding war to fund the final stages of Project Kraj, an experiment designed to choose its own evolution.
He explains that the dragon's fluid was needed to complete Experiment Kraj, and he works with partners Szadek and Savra and with the God-Zombie Svogthir in Savra's body.
Agrus Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowers Svogthir and kills Momir Vig before he can control Kraj, after which Kraj fights Rakdos to a draw.
